pericopes.title: Healing on the Sabbath
pericopes.imageAlt: A bowl of still water on a stone floor, the surface perfectly calm, morning light reflected in it from a high window

pericopes.title: On Humility
pericopes.imageAlt: A long stone table set for a meal, the seats nearest the viewer simple and rough, those at the far end more prominent

pericopes.title: The Great Banquet
pericopes.imageAlt: An elaborately set stone table with several clay cups and bread, everything prepared and waiting, completely empty of guests, warm evening light

pericopes.title: The Cost of Discipleship
pericopes.imageAlt: An unfinished stone foundation in open ground, the first courses laid precisely but the structure abandoned, overgrown at the edges

pericopes.title: Salt
pericopes.imageAlt: A small mound of salt on dark stone, the salt losing definition at its edges and dissolving into the damp stone
